head: 4b2cb54869fa8ee7b703bd62fdc1f68f477931c5
scope: Independent static visual review of all 42 phone status screenshots, plus read-only lifecycle snapshot interpretation
overallReason: Rage body state presence fails static identity. Two subtle foot auras need semantic evidence. Motion quality and sustained performance are not established.

statuses.reason: Foot flames remain contained; orange ring is clearer on blue enemy and still visible against player native fire.

Player aura nearly merges into native portrait flames; enemy has only faint red torso traces. Observed opacity about 0.47 on both sides, so this is not a zero-opacity instant. Body state presence is insufficient; a normal-combat icon may mitigate overall semantics but is not demonstrated here.
Ice cocoon fits portrait and clearly conveys hard control. Expected body covering does not invade adjacent actors or HUD.
Readable yellow stars above head on both sides; clear of HUD.
Pale green foot ring is weak against player native fire and similar to dinghaishenzhen; normal-combat motion/icon evidence is needed before requiring redesign.
Low pale cyan-white ring is faint and similar to dodgeSkill. No demonstrated placement defect; identity requires normal-combat motion/icon evidence.
Thin round bubble remains readable and preserves actor/HUD on both sides.
Fitted earth cocoon is distinct from ice freeze. Expected hard-control covering stays contained.
Sphere and elemental details remain visible while face and weapon stay readable.
Low rocks occupy feet/lower legs; upper actor and HUD remain clear.
Etched cylindrical enclosure and floor ring differ visibly from spherical shields; actor remains visible.
Gold-white lower-body blessing is visible and contained without nearby actor/HUD intrusion.
Additional orange-gold lower-body loop remains perceptible and preserves upper body; especially clear on enemy blue portrait.
Dark crimson foot flames differ visibly from ordinary burn; actor remains readable.
Snowflake icon is statically readable on both sides.
Boot/down-arrow icon is statically readable on both sides.
Damage-down icon is statically readable on both sides.
Shield/down-arrow icon is statically readable on both sides.
Red-gold phoenix icon is statically readable on both sides.
Expected portrait fading is visible on both sides while HUD remains readable; no body/icon is intentional.
No body/icon is intentional under existing presentation Owner; absence is not a missing-art failure.

sideConsistency: Both-side effect geometry follows portrait aspect ratio; no demonstrated side-specific anchoring or HUD regression. Hard-control covering is intentional and is not rejected for covering the face.

findings: First visible body layers rage/freeze change to freeze/shield, supporting layer rotation selection; opacity values are present.
Enemy count is 1 and sampled icon is 24x24 with z-index 34.
After cleanse only rage remains, supporting selective removal rather than clearing every status.
Expiry and death snapshots contain no body layers.
Revival shows shield again; final remaining count is 0.
limits: Lifecycle file itself contains no head/device/time fields; it is associated by artifact directory, not independently SHA-attested.
Snapshots do not show transition continuity, flicker, pulse cadence, rotation smoothness or duration.
This technical PASS is not animation-smoothness or sustained-performance acceptance.
Static PASS accepts visible composition/footprint/readability in these captured portraits only; it does not certify all roster art, simultaneous casts or arbitrary overlapping statuses.
Pulse/rotation continuity, interruption, frame pacing and long-session smoothness remain NEEDS_EVIDENCE.
Lifecycle snapshots support observed cleanup/death/revival states but cannot prove absence of transient residual pixels.
Rage screenshot does not demonstrate a normal-combat dedicated status icon adequately compensating for weak body identity.
No regeneration, runtime changes, phone operation or commit performed for this report.
stopRule: Retain statically passing presentations unless new player-visible defects appear. Do not iterate for minor hue preference, invisible pixels or arbitrary prompt padding.

contrastV2Followup.head: 590b1390631aaf550a5803e718325ae211baa818

findings.scope: Player and monster, including off/min/max comparison
findings.reason: At opacity .60, added orange-red side flames and lower-body loop are visibly different from off on both portraits. At .80 actor face, silhouette and HUD remain readable. Increased contrast resolves the observed weak body presence without enlarging footprint.
Height .74 makes pale cyan-white rising lower-body aura visibly taller than the low green dodgeSkill foot ring. Body and HUD remain readable.
Low green foot ring remains contained and is distinguishable from the revised taller pale cyan-white calm aura. No additional dodge art adjustment is justified by this static comparison.

contrastV2Followup.overallReason: Observed rage static defect is resolved. Revised calm aura and dodge pair are statically acceptable on player. Enemy revised calm comparison and motion/continuous performance evidence remain outstanding.
limits: Original review and counts remain historical; this append supersedes only the explicit scopes above.
New status-dinghaishenzhen and status-dodgeSkill evidence is player-side only. Do not claim a fresh enemy visual acceptance for height .74.
Off/min/max screenshots prove visibility/containment at sampled opacity endpoints, not pulse continuity or smooth layer rotation.
Dynamic recording has not been reviewed in this append.
No runtime changes, phone operation, commit or extra art iteration.
contrastV2Followup.stopRule: Seal accepted static composition unless new player-visible defects appear; do not pursue small aesthetic preferences.

contrastV2EnemyFollowup.head: 590b1390631aaf550a5803e718325ae211baa818

findings.reason: Enemy revised calm aura has a visible pale cyan-white rising lower-body envelope. It is taller and broader vertically than low green dodge ring, while face and HUD remain clear.
Enemy low green foot ring is discernible from the revised taller calm aura and remains contained.
Enemy orange-red side flames and lower loop are clearly visible against blue portrait; face/HUD remain readable. Confirms previous contrast endpoint PASS.

contrastV2EnemyFollowup.supersedes: Enemy revised calm geometry and pairwise identity NEEDS_EVIDENCE in contrastV2Followup
contrastV2EnemyFollowup.dynamicLimit: This reviewer attempted CUA background iab access, received Browser is not available: iab, and listBrowsers returned empty. No video was visually reviewed; root will review through available browser.
contrastV2EnemyFollowup.stopRule: All 21 static presentations are accepted within captured portrait scope; do not further iterate without new player-visible defects. Original history is retained.

sampledCycleReview.reason: All fourteen six-phase strips visually show essentially the same baseline portraits without their expected status bodies. Stun has no yellow head stars; freeze/petrify have no cocoon; rage enemy has no orange-red side aura visible in accepted static captures. These strips do not establish any sampled status cycle.
sampledCycleReview.followup: Check actual decoded frames after seek completion against original video and confirm recorded interval contains on-state. Do not change art to address this evidence issue.
limits: Even correct six-phase samples at 0.42 second intervals cannot prove 60fps or absence of inter-sample flicker/jumps.
Existing 21 static PASS results remain accepted; invalid or unverified sampled strips do not overturn those images.
No original video playback was possible in this reviewer browser surface.
